# outputs/top_event_sst_maps/ — SST Lifecycle Maps

Before / during / after spatial SST maps for top-10 **strongest** and **longest** events per region (thousands of PNG tiles + mosaics).

## Purpose

Visualize the spatial evolution of extreme catalogue events beyond regional-mean timeseries.

## Contents

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `strongest/`, `longest/` | Per-event map sets |
| `mosaics/` | Combined mosaic sheets |
| `index/` | Indexes / manifests |
| `run.log` | Generation log |

## Generated by

`src/climate/scripts/top_event_sst_lifecycle_maps.py`  
(reads `outputs/timeseries/combined_sst_2006_2025.nc`, catalogues, top-event lists)

## Upstream / Downstream

Top-event CSVs + merged SST cube → map archive → publication storytelling (related triptychs also under `outputs/publication/`).

## Notes

Large figure count; often gitignored. Regenerate only when SST cube and catalogues are final.
